
{{alias}}( x, alpha )
    Fills a single-precision floating-point ndarray with a specified value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: float32ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    alpha: number
        Fill value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: float32ndarray
        Input ndarray.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float32}}( [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 ] ) );
    > {{alias}}( x, 5.0 )
    <ndarray>
    > x.data
    <Float32Array>[ 5.0, 5.0, 5.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
